in_sanskrit.name: ईशानिका
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Daughter of Goddess Ishani, the presiding deity of knowledge and learning.

in_telugu.name: ైశానికే
in_telugu.long_meaning: Daughter of the God Ishan, the Lord of the Universe

in_marathi.name: Eshanika
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of wealth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Eshanika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Eshanika is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Eshana' meaning 'Goddess' and 'Nika' meaning 'Wealth'. This name is believed to bring prosperity and abundance in one's life.

in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Goddess of wealth
